lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 vertical white lines; spacing is irregular, characterized by narrower intervals in the center-mass and increasing distance between segments towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Observed abbreviated line segments on the posterior rump and the anterior shoulder regions where lines fail to reach the ventral or dorsal boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper lateral hind limb and haunch area.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse chevron/band across the lower neck at the junction with the torso.
